```text

     │                                  │

            VERIFIED EVIDENCE
                    ↓
          contextual capability estimates
                    ↓

     ↓                             ↓
WORK ROUTING               ACTIVE LEARNING
best proven worker    "what should we test next?"
     │                             │
     ↓                             ↓
actual outcome ────────────→ capability graph
```
